description: This file defines utility extension functions for Android's Context class and a NoteColor extension to resolve resource IDs and retrieve assets like drawables and dimensions, facilitating theming and styling within the app.

classes.name: NoteColor
classes.description: An enum class (assumed) representing different note colors, used for theming/styling notes in the app.

methods.name: resolveAttribute
methods.description: Resolves a theme attribute to its data value, returning null if not resolved.

methods.name: getDrawableCompat
methods.description: Retrieves a drawable resource in a compatible way across different Android versions.

methods.name: getDimensionAttribute
methods.description: Resolves a theme attribute to a dimension pixel size.

methods.name: resId
methods.description: Maps a NoteColor to its corresponding theme attribute resource ID and resolves it.
